rationale.private_send_bound: deliver_keyed has exactly one caller: the existing ResultMailbox<T> implementation requiring T: Serialize + DeserializeOwned + Send + Sync. Its previously unbounded private impl independently compiled a future retaining &Delivery<T> across pool.begin().await, which needs T: Sync for Send. Add T: Sync only to that private helper impl, matching the proven caller; no public trait/type/constructor/sweeper bounds change and no owned-argument redesign.
rationale.const: Both cfg branches of idempotency_scope return an input reference or static empty string and are const-capable. Normal duplicate_outcome only constructs DeliveryOutcome::Duplicate by moving original status; mark it const. OA07 cfg version clones retry status and stays non-const.
rationale.preserved: Existing rustdoc repair, SQL transaction/row-lock/fresh-snapshot sequence, original status/TTL, OA06 address control, OA07 retry-status control and S7 consume control remain unchanged.
rationale.semantic_implications: No runtime behavior change intended. Only a private helper gains an already-required caller bound; eligible pure helpers gain const qualification. The generic core ResultMailbox<T: Send> trait remains unchanged; PG existing implementation still requires Sync as before.

execution: Source reads, exact local edits and known-file hashes only. No builds/tests/Cargo/Clippy/fmt/review/lint allows/refactor/commits/KBD. Central/immutable verification tree and source maps untouched.
